reasoning: This is the standard automotive UI glyph for upper-body/face ventilation (air blowing toward a seated passenger), though in a general task app viewers also read it as selecting a passenger seat. It fits narrow tasks around car dashboard vents/airflow and airline or train seat selection.

pass1.ambiguity: Actually a standard automotive HVAC 'face vent' icon (air blowing toward seated occupant's upper body), which outside a car dashboard can look like 'choose seat', 'push person back', or 'assign to seated passenger'.
